scope: Four byte-distinct PS4 9.00 GTA V menu builds selected from the requested GamerHack repository. Original upstream downloads only; no unverified Load transport or public mirror.
notes: Group under existing WildeModz and ArabicGuy menu families. Keep game update and menu release separate.
Exact hashes differ from earlier Nazky/Kameleon builds; retain every previous action and archived file.
Source-host in-page loading is evidence for that host pairing only. No downloaded console code was executed.

actions.firmwareEvidence: Pinned 900v3/index.html identifies PS4 9.00 and maps the exact menu function to this BIN. No other firmware or PS5 support is inferred.

loaderEvidence.transport: In-page XMLHttpRequest ArrayBuffer copied into native executable memory, then passed to pthread_create. No generic external loading transport is enabled.

actions.license: No redistribution licence was established for this compiled menu. Preserve original authorship and host attribution; original upstream download only.

actions.imageDescription: Existing GTA V artwork reused from this menu family; not a screenshot or hardware verification of the exact build.
requirements: PS4 firmware 9.00 and GTA V game update 1.38; the game update is separate from console firmware.
No regional CUSA list was supplied for this exact build. Confirm the title ID and executable before using it.

Use the matching original host or a native loader confirmed compatible with this exact build. Keep one game menu active at a time.
